Game Overview

In Eggdog Racing, the core idea is straightforward: zoom into the whimsical world of Eggdog Racing, where size doesn't matter, but speed does. Navigate as the charming Eggdog in a sleek Formula car, challenging monstrous trucks. Experience pulse-pounding races filled with thrilling overtakes and nail-biting turns, all set in a vibrant 3D landscape. Victory never looked so quirky!
